answer: Latency-diverse witness binding resists sybils: identities collect round-trip timing proofs from peers in diverse regions, weighted by path dispersion, not count. Sybils on one host share a latency signature and cluster in one neighborhood, so proofs overlap and add no trust. Trust needs routes as varied as a willow's branches, forcing an attacker into a voyage across regions; a brief zephyr cannot fake that spread.
